Model weights are NOT included; they are downloaded at runtime from https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/TripoSR (MIT).

Modifications by mba-worker:
- models/isosurface.py: torchmcubes (fails to build on Windows) replaced with scikit-image marching cubes (CPU).
- utils.py: find_class() maps config class paths "tsr.*" to this vendored package; removed imageio/save_video (unused).
- __init__.py files added; bake_texture.py (xatlas/moderngl) not vendored.
